skill.summary: Clawdbot documentation expert with decision tree navigation, search scripts, doc fetching, version tracking, and config snippets for all Clawdbot features

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Clawdbot documentation expert skill.

- Provides decision tree navigation to quickly identify relevant documentation.
- Supports searching, fetching, and indexing docs with included CLI scripts.
- Offers detailed documentation categories for all Clawdbot features.
- Includes ready-to-use config snippets for common scenarios.
- Adds workflow guidance and tips for efficient support and documentation lookup.
